ff-medical-education-accessibility.note: Knowledge Bridge now exposes explicit keyboard/screen-reader semantics: named search input, explanation-depth radio group, topic selection state, live status, causal-stage list semantics, and visible focus rings. No dependency or external API path was added.

ff-medical-education-checklist.note: Knowledge Bridge adds a static provenance-aware study verification checklist covering source identity/date, population/context/units, uncertainty, management-claim safeguards, and an explicit non-clinical-clearance boundary. No new API, dependency, polling, storage, or patient-specific inference was added.

ff-medical-education-glossary.note: Knowledge Bridge expands each of its seven causal-stage labels with a concise plain-language definition at point of use while bridgeSummary preserves the canonical stage labels used by existing exports/tests. The glossary is a fixed seven-entry map reused by every curated topic, adding no dependency, network call, polling, storage, large asset, or patient-specific inference.

ff-medical-education-evidence.note: Matured the existing Knowledge Bridge evidence panel instead of duplicating UI: the evidence shelf is bounded to eight source pointers, sanitizes persisted entries, deduplicates by stable key, preserves source/year/identifier/query/original URL, supports deterministic remove/clear, and explicitly states that a selected source pointer is not a verified claim until the original source is opened. No new API, dependency, polling, large asset, or patient-specific inference was added.
